entries.revision_reason: Material evidence from three completed units after Amendment-2 ratification (merged 2026-07-31). (1) The prerequisite-registry lane proved all nine crosswalk registries foreign-key the official PSID inventory, which the operative source adjudication declares not emitted, so registries cannot precede a source repin. (2) The questionnaire-extraction unit (merged, referee-confirmed SHIP) closed the V-B5 and V-B8 evidentiary residuals entirely but left one genuine V-B6 residual: no document among the 456 captured questionnaire/procedures volumes supplies the exact allocation from V4901-V4906 secondary-job components to the annual V4379/V5289/V5788 wife labor-income totals, confirmed by two independent corpus-wide sweeps. (3) The design's own registration truth table aborts the fitting-free witness while any V-B row fails, so resolution now requires: an outside-corpus evidence hunt for the allocation rule, a prospectively-replacing source-identity amendment (Amendment 3, drafting), its ratification and registry repin, the nine prerequisite registries with separate reviews, the crosswalk commit ceremony, the value-blind registrability adjudication, and the A1/A3 capture ceremony before registration and the sealed run. p50 moves two days on the amendment-and-registries stack; the p80 tail carries the risk that the allocation rule is unrecoverable outside the corpus and the V-B6 requirement needs its own ratified revision.

entries.revision_reason: Material evidence from the amendment cascade and the measured R_Q scale wall, all landed after entry 14 registered. (1) Four further design amendments proved necessary and were ratified through adversarial rounds: A3 (successor V-B source identity + comparator census, revision 5), A4 (V-B6 inclusive-total fact revision, revision 6), A5 (consolidated legal schema and official-inventory dispositions, five rounds, revision 7), and A6 (fixed-width missing-token grammar completion, four rounds, revision 8, merged 2026-08-02 via #356/#358) whose ratified totality census maps all 89,599 inventory fields with total literal registration. (2) A5's schema law requires ONE global six-era 43-wave Q5 annotation artifact; stage 1 sealed 469,198 candidate review rows over 81 questionnaire documents and the per-document annotation factory has sealed 12 of 81 with a measured cadence of ~12 documents/day on three lanes, putting corpus completion near 2026-08-05 with era seals, the global catalog, reverse-cover, and independent reconstruction review behind it. (3) The legal-registry lane (merged #357) narrowed six source gaps to two, both still registration-blocking until captured (Section 218 instrument universe, inventory-gated; base determinations 1975-77 and 1982-89). (4) Official-inventory emission became lawful only with revision 8 and its first attempt is in flight. The remaining chain - inventory, nine crosswalk registries, the single-add crosswalk ceremony, value-blind registrability adjudication, capture ceremony, fresh registration, sealed run, publication - sits behind the R_Q long pole, moving p50 from 2026-08-06 to 2026-08-10.

entries.revision_reason: Material evidence from the continued amendment cascade, the stage-4 fail-closed discovery, and lane capacity, all landed after entry 15 registered (2026-08-02). (1) Five further design amendments proved necessary and were ratified through adversarial referee rounds: A7 (consumption-boundary law, revision 9, #360/#361), A8 (analytic range partitions, revision 10, #363/#364), A9 (arm-ambiguous serializability, revision 11, merged 2026-08-03 via #365/#366), A10 (unit authority, revision 12, merged 2026-08-05 via #368/#369), and A11 (missing-reason authority, revision 13, merged 2026-08-06 via #370/#371); the 81-document corpus is fully sealed with six era consolidations. (2) The stage-4 disposition pass then failed closed (report 2026-08-05), surfacing repeat-instruction semantics outside the ratified laws; Amendment 12 was chartered the same day and through four completed adversarial rounds plus five fix cycles (2026-08-05 through 2026-08-07) grew into a full repeat-encounter law — a five-arm partition with an explicit continuation rule, typed pairwise decomposition of composite instructions, and a semantic-ledger-only gate to the alias arm. Round 5, the ratification attempt, is in flight at registration time. (3) The Amendment 12 charter adopted a two-tier protocol — pilot-slice lawmaking followed by full-corpus tier-2 certification — inserting a corpus-wide repair pass (tier-2 repair total currently measured at 46 = 36 + 10 at the fifth fix cycle) between ratification and the stage-5+ chain that entry 15's dates assumed would follow stage 4 directly. (4) Lane capacity collapsed across the window: travel-window process kills on 2026-08-05/06 and weekly usage caps left three of four Codex lanes capped or unauthenticated as of 2026-08-07 (stated resets 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-11), with a single live lane carrying both round-5 referees. Remaining chain to the criterion: A12 ratification and revision-14 repin, tier-2 certification, H/O_H reverse-cover, reconstruction review, Q5, official inventory, crosswalks, adjudication, capture, gate registration, the sealed one-shot run, and the publication PR. p50 moves 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-14; p80 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-20.

entries.revision_reason: Material evidence landed after entry 16 registered (2026-08-07). (1) The tier-2 execution chain required two further ratified amendments: A13 (tier-2 execution law: terminal successor status for the 28 incompatible proof rows, fragment disclosure/composition law, blob-bound ratification identity; ratified 2026-08-08, merged #377, revision 15 via #378 after a squash-orphan incident cured by #379) and A14 (operative-convention scope correction replacing A13's self-blocking external-PKI recording machinery with the codified dual-RATIFY + committed-verdict + closure convention; operator-authorized, ratified and merged #380, revision 16 + operative closures via #381). (2) Tier-2 A12-T2-R03 then executed the complete reseal obligation on 2026-08-09 — exactly 46 repairs with 46 supersession edges, all six successor era seals, corpus-exhaustive sweeps over all 81 documents with zero unexplained hits, 89/89 mutations — but the certification PR #382 was squash-merged, collapsing the enacted §27.2.3 cl.3-5 first-add ordering (overlays strictly before seals strictly before evidence) into one commit: master's Tests now fail (test__live_git_order__validates_before_and_after_publication, 'an overlay first-add is not a strict ancestor of its era seal') and the cure is underdetermined under current law because first-add history is immutable and the validator requires at most one add-commit per path. Amendment 15 is drafting to enact the ordered-ceremony-branch attestation cure (the true ordered history is preserved at ceremony-archive/a12-tier2-r03-ordered, tip tree byte-identical to the squash tree), a merge-mode law, and the tier-2 certification schema. All PRs are blocked on the red master until it lands. (3) A section-cited endgame mapping against the revision-16 design established that roughly 17-18 macro gates remain between the current state and this entry's criterion, including the full tier-2 step-5 source build (H, O_H, reverse covers, dispositions, catalogs, executable R_Q), the A12-T2-R05 dual-adversarial reconstruction certification, the R06 rerun reproducing the Amendment 11 abort, and — dominating the remaining schedule — the separately ratified source-authority and lifecycle successor program the design requires before Q5 (SS25.10.2, SS26.10.3): authenticated separately registered source-backed evidence covering 524,538 literals without disposition authority plus 37,283 structural-null ranges, a total no-default disposition/reason law, and rebuilt terminal/storage facts, gates, comparator closure, and lifecycle.
